{{Quote|Yes, the Senate has chosen a representative to the Alliance of Free Planets: Josek Haime, of Gesco City.|[[Gaeriel Captison]]|<ref name="Truce">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Gesco City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Truce" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gesco City was first mentioned in the [[1996]] ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Truce" />
